title: Entries Read by an Entrance Fee Agreement Annual Tax Letter
content:
The window of entries an annual tax letter of an **Entrance Fee Agreement** reads is fixed by the letter on the ledger before it: where the latest tax letter on the agreement was issued 23 or more whole months before the issue date, the letter is a missed-run letter and reads the entries posted 13 to 24 whole months before the issue date; where the agreement has no tax letter yet, the letter reads the entries posted from 1 whole month before the issue date back to the month of the latest deposit payment; in every other case it reads the entries posted 1 to 12 whole months before the issue date.

Stated as month counts before the issue date: a missed-run letter reads entries at least 13 and fewer than 25 whole months old; the ordinary letter reads entries at least 1 and fewer than 13 whole months old; a first letter reads entries at least 1 whole month old and no older than the month of the latest deposit payment on the agreement's ledger.

## Window table

| Tax letters on the agreement's ledger | Window read |
|---|---|
| Latest issued 23 or more whole months before the issue date | 13 to 24 whole months before the issue date |
| None | From 1 whole month before the issue date back to the month of the latest deposit payment |
| Latest issued fewer than 23 whole months before the issue date | 1 to 12 whole months before the issue date |

## Boundaries of the latest letter's age

| Whole months since the latest tax letter | Window |
|---|---|
| 23 | 13 to 24 months (missed run) |
| 22 | 1 to 12 months |

## Boundaries of an entry's age (ordinary window)

| Whole months between posting and issue | Read |
|---|---|
| 0 | No |
| 1 | Yes |
| 12 | Yes |
| 13 | No |

## Hypothetical first letter

No tax letter on the ledger and the latest deposit payment posted 20 whole months before the issue date: the letter reads the entries posted 1 to 20 whole months before the issue date.
